title: Book One · Chapter 5: Three Bowls
story:
Dad knocks on the front door of the yard.

A woman opens it. She has a towel over one arm.

"I'm Mrs Lan," she tells Ronan. "You are the little one!"

"I'm six."

"So you are six."

Dad points to the tap. "May I have a look? I can turn off the water first."

Mrs Lan puts her towel on a chair. She shows him a handle near the wall.

"Please do. I hear it all day. Even in bed!"

Dad gets his blue box. Ronan takes the bowl from under the tap. There is water in it now.

"Where do I put this water?"

"In my wash bucket," Mrs Lan says. "Not all on the plant. It isn't a fish."

Ronan carries the bowl with both hands. A little water runs over his fingers. Mrs Lan holds the bucket low for him.

Dad takes the tap apart. There is a small black ring inside. One side is flat and broken. He shows it to Mrs Lan.

"I have another in my box."

Ronan watches from beside the door. He wants to touch the open tap, but Dad is working with both hands.

"Can I do something?"

"Keep that little part in the bowl. I don't want it down the hole."

Ronan puts it in the dry bowl. The part is very small. But Dad needs it to finish the tap.

Dad turns the water on again. The tap stays quiet.

Mrs Lan turns it once. Water runs. She closes it. Nothing falls.

"Now I can hear my clock," she says.

Dad puts his tools away. Mum calls them to dinner. There is rice, an egg with tomatoes, and a small bowl of soup. The table is a board on two boxes. Dad checks it before Mum puts the hot food down.

Ronan brings three bowls from the kitchen. He puts the biggest one at Dad's place.

"Why do I get this?" Dad asks.

"You did the tap."

"I did dinner," Mum says.

Ronan changes the bowls. Now Mum has the big one.

"I carried the bowl of water," he says.

Dad looks at Mum. Mum looks at Dad. They both slide the big bowl toward Ronan.

He laughs and pushes it into the middle.

"We can all look at it."

They eat from their own bowls. Mum gives Dad the last piece of egg. Dad puts half of it into hers. Ronan watches carefully. No one moves his egg.

"Is the old shop empty now?" he asks.

"Almost," Dad says. "I need to give the key back."

"Why can't we work there?"

"I cannot pay for the old place now. Some work went wrong too. I still need to pay for those mistakes."

Ronan looks down at his rice.

"Was it my bike?"

"No," Dad says at once. "I did some work badly. Your bike didn't cause that."

Mum puts a hand on Dad's arm. Then she asks Ronan to pass the tomatoes.

Outside, someone opens the gate. Mrs Lan comes in with two spring onions.

"For tomorrow," she says. "Your dinner smells better than mine."

Mum invites her to sit. "My food is ready at home," Mrs Lan says.

Ronan looks at the quiet tap through the window. He can hear three people eating. His bowl is warm in his hands. Mum asks for more rice. Dad passes it to her. Ronan stays at the table with them.
studyGuide:
## 先看情节提示也可以

爸爸先得到房主同意再修水龙头，随后一家人在新家一起吃第一顿饭。

## 从认词到读句子

1. **Dad / gets / his blue box.** 爸爸／拿来／他的蓝色工具箱。
2. **Mum / calls them / to dinner.** 妈妈／叫他们／来吃晚饭；them指爸爸和Ronan。

---

重点表达：turn off＝关掉；tap＝水龙头；bowl＝碗；ring＝小圆圈。

辅助理解：black ring是水龙头里的一只黑色小垫圈，用来防止漏水。

理解问题：

1. Dad 修水龙头前做了什么？
2. 第一顿饭中，什么事情让一家人笑起来？
